extracted.name: Pea, Cabbage, Parmesan and Mint Salad
extracted.description: This is one of those salads where it only takes one bite to know that you could eat the entire bowl yourself as a meal instead of sharing it between 4 as a side. Adapted from a recipe by Karen Martini, a great Australian chef.
ingredient_lines: 3 cups green or white cabbage (, finely sliced)
instruction_lines: Reserve 1 tbsp of the parmesan cheese as garnish.
Place all ingredients in a bowl and toss gently to combine.
Allow to sit for 5 minutes to allow the cabbage to wilt slightly.
Adjust seasoning with extra salt and pepper (if required), garnish with reserved 1 tbsp parmesan cheese and serve.
